name: Mighty Clipedge
description: Opens each form with the blade raised and then rolled over the shoulder like a hawk shifting its wing.

name: Thunderclap Bulkblade
description: Drops from the raised perch guard into a plain chop at the opponent's lead shoulder.

name: Chunkgrace
description: Glides to the side like a hawk's shadow crossing the ground, leaving the cut to land where the body was.

name: Deluge Nubtip
description: Closes the flat on the opposing blade like a talon, throwing it off its line.

name: Bedrock Wedgetip
description: Rolls the falchion over the shoulder and draws the belly down across the opponent's near arm.

name: Titan Falchhilt
description: Rises on a lifted heel with the blade across the brow so a falling blow slides off the flat.

name: Steelstump
description: Turns the body round and chops back across the line the opponent had thought safe.

name: Sigilnub
description: Circles the opponent's blade with the falchion's belly and holds it against the ground with its weight.

name: Vigor Whack
description: Falls from the full roll with the whole weight of the body behind a single heavy chop.

name: Squall Thickspine
description: Turns a heavy cut away on the roll and stoops in a counter chop before the guard can recover.

name: Steel Weightbelly
description: Drives the qi field out through the clipped point in a dive that pierces a hardened guard.

name: Nubtipcrown
description: The school's finishing stoop, in which the held roll is released as a single great falling cut from above.

name: Enshrined Heavyback
description: Stands square with the falchion held between the two opposing lines as the school's courts are drawn.

name: Bedrock Chopblade
description: Chops down on the near side of the court line, the first of the paired strokes.

name: Quenched Hash
description: Returns the blade across the court line in a second chop on the far side.

name: Cleaverbelly Boon
description: Shuffles along the line of the court with the blade trailing, keeping a pace between the two fighters.

name: Pall Thickspine
description: Parries on the near edge of the court and turns the same blade over into a parry on the far edge.

name: Bedrock Hack
description: Cuts the near line and the far line in the school's set order, two heavy strokes in a pair.

name: Majestic Falchhilt
description: Lands a heavy chop on the court line that carries the falchion's swell through a raised guard.

name: Pall Chopblade
description: Weighs the opponent's blow against the falchion's own and returns it balanced, with a chop on the opened side.

name: Vigor Hew
description: Releases the qi field on both court lines in a single chop that falls on the guard and the arm behind it.

name: Unrivaled Steel Cleft
description: The school's sealing form, in which both court lines are cut in one stroke after the long opening stance.

name: Steel Bulkblade
description: Opens in a low stance with the blade lowered like a river reaching its mouth.

name: Inferno Clipedge
description: Chops down at the edge of the opponent's guard where the hollow of the guard begins.

name: Windborne Chunk
description: Steps aside as a stream parts around a stone, leaving the opposing blade in open water.

name: Squall Weightbelly
description: Catches the opposing blade in the curved hollow of the falchion and carries it out and down.

name: Prismnub
description: Gathers the opponent's pressure over several blows in the curve of the blade, as a basin gathers rain.

name: Steel Heavyback
description: Runs the belly of the blade along the opponent's guard like a river along its bank, ending at the hand.

name: Vigornubtip
description: Bends the footing round a pivot so the next cut comes from the outside of the opposing guard.

name: Thrall Whack
description: Rolls the blade in a small eddy about the opposing weapon until it is caught against the spine.

name: Haemalchunk
description: Releases the pressure the basin has gathered in a cleave that spills over the opposing guard.

name: Eclipse Wedgetip
description: Lets the blow rise along the curve of the blade and sends a measure of its force back on the attacker.

name: Vacuum Heavyback
description: Draws a great blow into the field held in the guard and returns it in a heavy cut.

name: Triumphant Chunk
description: The school's flood form, in which all gathered force is released at once in a wide falling cut.

name: Colossal Thickspine
description: Holds the falchion out and rocks it gently as a hawk holds its wings before a stoop.

name: Steel Cleaverbelly
description: Chops on the downbeat of the wing, the heavy part of the blade falling first.

name: Feather Nubtip
description: Takes the foot back on the upbeat of the wing while the blade lifts to guard.

name: Pall Nubtip
description: Parries a blow on the downbeat and a second on the upbeat, with the falchion rising and falling like a wing.

name: Exalted Hack
description: Hacks in the rhythm of the wingbeat, the two beats landing on separate parts of the guard.

name: Vigor Chopblade
description: Glides two steps on the paired beat, landing the blade on the second.

name: Peremptory Hash
description: Presses the opposing blade down with the falchion's weight on the downbeat and holds it through the upbeat.

name: Bedrock Chunk
description: Falls on the paired beat with both wingbeats gathered into one chop of great weight.

name: Parity Clipedge
description: Folds the guard in on itself like a wing and counters from the fold with a short chop.

name: Sovereign Hew
description: Throws the falchion's field out on both wing arcs, cutting those standing to either side.

name: Thunderclap Hew
description: The school's paired fall, in which two great chops arrive on one beat from either wing.

name: Tranquil Falchhilt
description: Opens each form by breathing the field into the legs and blade on separate tracks.

name: Haemalstump
description: Chops along the first track with the pale field gathered on the falling edge.

name: Delugenub
description: Crosses the stepping foot on the second track so the blade and the body part ways at the moment of the cut.

name: Weightbelly Reliquary
description: Hoods the head and shoulder with the field and rests the blade's spine along the forearm.

name: Clement Cleaverbelly
description: Reads the opponent's field with the track kept for sight, leaving the blade track free to cut.

name: Nubtippledge
description: Turns a blow with the blade track while the leg track sets the body in the next position.

name: Bulkblade Triumph
description: Pulls the belly across the opponent with both tracks feeding it, the cut deepening along the drag.

name: Vigor Hash
description: Closes a wide gap in two bounds, each bound on its own track, ending inside the falchion's reach.

name: Hacktriumph
description: Joins both tracks in a falling cleave that arrives with the force of the whole body.

name: Gloom Whack
description: Presses the opponent from both tracks with alternating cuts so no answering stroke can begin.

name: Peerless Wedgetip
description: Sweeps the falchion through a full circle with the field following, cutting all in the blade's orbit.

name: Matchless Steel Wedgetip
description: The school's full dual fall, in which both tracks are released onto one line after the opening breath.

name: Nubpledge
description: Raises the falchion above the head like a crest and stands motionless before the first cut.

name: Bedrock Nubtip
description: Lets the raised blade fall in a plain chop with the swell leading the cut.

name: Squall Hew
description: Moves forward without bobbing, so that the raised blade stays level through the step.

name: Haemalhew
description: Feeds the formed Core's steady qi into the edge so the hack bites deeper than the arm's own strength.

name: Parity Thickspine
description: Steadies the arm from the Core and turns heavy blows aside with the flat.

name: Sigil Cleaverbelly
description: Presses the swell onto the opposing weapon and holds it down with the Core's even outflow.

name: Pulsarwhack
description: Drives Core qi down the clipped point and through guard and armor in one stroke.

name: Thunderous Chopblade
description: Raises a heavy wall of Core qi along the broad flat to stop the weight of a great blow.

name: Haemalcleft
description: Brings the crest down with the Core's whole outflow, cleaving through the strongest guard.

name: Noble Clipedge Verdict
description: The school's highest chop, in which the held crest is released in one fall the Core has long gathered.

name: Nubseal
description: Opens by speaking the oath of the wind and setting the falchion across the body.

name: Squallchunk
description: Chops as the last word of the oath is spoken, voice and blade landing together.

name: Squallcleft
description: Steps lightly along the edge of a gust, leaving no weight on the foot the wind might lift.

name: Stumppledge
description: Blocks a cut on the flat as if the oath bound the blade in place.

name: Haemalwhack
description: Hacks on a pulse of qi that rides the wind and lands with more weight than the steel alone.

name: Deluge Weightbelly
description: Pivots on a flat plateau foot, turning the blade in line with the cut.

name: Hewverdict
description: Cleaves along a sworn line, the qi falling as steadily as a wind off the plateau.

name: Prism Heavyback
description: Holds the guard unmoved through a long assault, steady as the plateau under the feet.

name: Radiance Whack
description: Concentrates the field on the point and drives through a guard with a sound like wind through a gap.

name: Thunderclap Falchhilt
description: The school's oath-bound fall, in which the whole sworn word is released in one heavy cut.

name: Luminous Chopblade
description: Stands still and takes a bearing on the opponent before the blade is raised.

name: Cleft Banner
description: Chops directly along the bearing the stance has taken, the falchion's weight following the line.

name: Squallnub
description: Advances without losing the bearing, adjusting the footing so the blade keeps its aim.

name: Pallstump
description: Turns a cut off the bearing by a hand's breadth, so the blow misses and the line stays open.

name: Intrepid Bulkblade
description: Beats out hacks along a held aim, with qi in the forearm keeping each stroke on its line.

name: Vigor Chunk
description: Shifts the bearing a quarter turn as the wind shifts, bringing the blade onto the opponent's open side.

name: Statute Cleaverbelly
description: Crosses the guard on the bearing line so a cut meeting it glances off on the flat.

name: Unbending Hash
description: Presses the opposing blade across its own bearing and breaks the line of its next cut.

name: Imperial Hash
description: Lets the cleave fall along the bearing's whole length with qi drawn from the legs.

name: Sainted Nubtip
description: Reverses the bearing at the instant of a clash and cuts from the opposite quarter.

name: Triumphant Falchhilt
description: Holds the bearing steady while the field gathers, then drives the point through any guard on the line.

name: Unrivaled Cleft Verdict
description: The school's fixed-bearing finish, in which the blade falls along the taken line with the whole stance behind it.

name: Squall Hack
description: Starts running with the wind at the back and the blade carried low and trailing.

name: Haemal Hack
description: Lifts the falchion at the end of the run and chops with the body's momentum.

name: Enshrined Clipedge
description: Catches the opponent's stroke as a gust would catch a banner, turning it aside.

name: Wedgetip Crown
description: Skims the blade low across the ground and hacks at the opponent's ankle.

name: Deluge Hew
description: Lets qi surge into the legs on the rush of a gale, carrying the body in long strides.

name: Heavyback Vow
description: Holds the falchion overhead and spins it slightly to deflect blows from above like a gale-driven blade.

name: Exalted Weightbelly
description: Chops twice in succession at the end of the rush, the second landing as the first is parried.

name: Unrivaled Chunk
description: Releases the whole rush in a single fall of the blade that overwhelms a raised guard.

name: Wraithlike Bulkblade
description: Runs through the opponent's reach with a slashing cut and ends with the back turned to the cut.

name: Thunderclap Whack
description: Charges on the field's gale and cleaves in the same instant with the whole momentum of the rush.

name: Exalted Cleft Triumph
description: The school's finishing charge, in which the gathered rush falls from the blade as one great heavy cut.

name: Sacrosanct Thickspine
description: Stands with nothing behind and nothing beside, the falchion held ready on the open plateau.

name: Vigorhack
description: Chops in the open without a wall to lean on, the body's weight set fully into the cut.

name: Nubtipboon
description: Steps freely in all directions, with no wall to restrict the turns, keeping the blade moving.

name: Pealstump
description: Parries in a wide circle that covers the whole front, since no wall guards the flank.

name: Squallhash
description: Chops in a series without moving the feet, the whole body set against the open ground.

name: Bedrock Cleft
description: Retreats in a sweeping curve that turns the blade between the fighters at every step.

name: Unrivaled Whack
description: Cleaves in the open with room to swing the falchion through its fullest arc.

name: Venerable Nubtip
description: Holds a spinning guard on every side at once, as one fighting without walls must.

name: Heavyback Edict
description: Releases the field in a wide ring around the falchion, cutting all who stand within the open ground.

name: Splendid Hack
description: The school's open-ground finish, in which one stroke is held until the whole field of the plateau is gathered.

name: Devout Bulkblade
description: Speaks the oath and takes the bearing together as the falchion is raised.

name: Majestic Cleft
description: Hacks on the bearing at the close of the oath with the field gathered round the blade.

name: Deluge Falchhilt
description: Steps in even paces along the bearing while the oath's rhythm is kept in the breath.

name: Revelation Chopblade
description: Casts the field along the bearing like a line on the wind to feel where the opponent stands.

name: Wedgetip Reliquary
description: Beats a parry backed by the held oath, so the blow is turned and the stance remains.

name: Fearless Hew
description: Chains chops along a held bearing, each stroke a measured step closer.

name: Nubvoyage
description: Turns away on the oath line to leave a cut passing through empty air.

name: Steelhew
description: Cleaves with the whole of the oath's weight gathered in the field behind the edge.

name: Season Cleaverbelly
description: Presses forward with oath-held cuts that leave the opponent no bearing to answer from.

name: Thunderclap Hack
description: Delivers the sworn cut with the field wholly gathered, cleaving through guard and weapon alike.

name: Steelhash
description: The school's sworn fall, in which the oath is kept and the blade comes down on the bearing once.

name: Sovereign Thickspine
description: Stands on the high ground of the school's stance with the falchion held at the shoulder.

name: Haemal Hash
description: Chops with the Core's outflow riding the wind through the cut.

name: Dunenub
description: Moves lightly on the Core's steady outflow, crossing ground with no wasted motion.

name: Stately Clipedge
description: Parries with the broad flat as a peak turns wind, sending the opposing blade away.

name: Squall Whack
description: Hacks with the Core's outflow steadying the edge so each stroke lands exactly where aimed.

name: Feather Thickspine
description: Turns on the high ground, the blade following the wind round the opponent's guard.

name: Steelnub
description: Raises a shield of Core qi shaped like a gale around the blade, turning blows aside.

name: Thrallhack
description: Holds the opposing blade down under the Core's outflow and draws the belly across it.

name: Quenched Chunk
description: Cleaves from the highest ground with the Core's outflow gathered along the whole edge.

name: Stately Chopblade
description: Counters a blow from the heights of the stance, turning it aside and cutting in the same instant.

name: Famed Hew
description: Lets the Core's outflow descend from the blade in a gale that cuts all within the falchion's reach.

name: Fearless Thunderclap Cleaverbelly
description: The school's summit stroke, in which the Core's whole outflow is gathered and released in one heavy cut.
